home.name: Prati home base (near Ottaviano / Lepanto)
home.summary: One Airbnb for the week — lift or ground floor, washer, kitchen, crib. Address TBD.

places.name: Rome Fiumicino Airport (FCO)
places.summary: Arrival Mon Nov 16 ~7:00am · Departure Tue Nov 24 AZ 618 10:10am.
places.imageAlt: The Terminal 1 exterior at Rome Fiumicino Airport (FCO).
places.imageCredit: Photo: Ra Boe · CC BY-SA 3.0 DE · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: St Peter’s Square
places.summary: Colonnade, obelisk, security queues. Meeting point for the audience.
places.imageAlt: St Peter’s Square in Vatican City, with the basilica façade and Bernini’s colonnade.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Dietmar Rabich · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: St Peter’s Basilica
places.summary: Free entry. Pietà, baldachin, nave. Skip the dome with baby/toddler.
places.imageAlt: The nave of St Peter’s Basilica looking toward the papal altar and baldachin.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Radosław Botev · CC BY 3.0 PL · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Bronze Door (Portone di Bronzo)
places.summary: Ticket pickup for the General Audience. Apostolic Palace, right colonnade of St Peter’s Square.
places.imageAlt: Swiss Guard at the Bronze Door (Portone di Bronzo) on St Peter’s Square.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Fred Romero · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Pantheon
places.summary: Vast round hall with an open oculus. Timed tickets; under-18 free but still need a ticket.
places.imageAlt: Interior of the Pantheon in Rome, with light falling from the open oculus.
places.imageCredit: Photo: John Samuel · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Santa Maria sopra Minerva
places.summary: Gothic basilica; Michelangelo’s Christ; St Catherine’s tomb. Usually opens mid-morning.
places.imageAlt: The façade of Santa Maria sopra Minerva and Bernini’s elephant obelisk in the piazza.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Merulana · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: San Luigi dei Francesi
places.summary: Caravaggio’s St Matthew cycle in the Contarelli Chapel. Free; midday closure.
places.imageAlt: The façade of San Luigi dei Francesi, the French national church in Rome.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Sailko · CC BY 2.5 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Trevi Fountain
places.summary: Street view free. Inner basin has controlled entry. Quick photos — don’t linger.
places.imageAlt: The Trevi Fountain in Rome, with Oceanus in the central niche.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Diego Delso · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Spanish Steps
places.summary: Piazza di Spagna and the steps to Trinità dei Monti.
places.imageAlt: The Spanish Steps rising from Piazza di Spagna toward Trinità dei Monti.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Steven Lek · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Castel Sant’Angelo
places.summary: Hadrian’s tomb turned fortress. Stairs; exterior + bridge is enough if the museum is too much.
places.imageAlt: Castel Sant’Angelo and Ponte Sant’Angelo across the Tiber in Rome.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Jean-Pol GRANDMONT · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Colosseum
places.summary: Timed entry. Standard tiers — not arena/underground. Book all nine ~30 days out.
places.imageAlt: The exterior of the Colosseum in Rome.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Jebulon · CC0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Arch of Constantine
places.summary: Free exterior stop next to the Colosseum.
places.imageAlt: The Arch of Constantine beside the Colosseum in Rome.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Alessandroferri · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Roman Forum
places.summary: Combined ticket with Colosseum area. Uneven stones — carrier often better than stroller.
places.imageAlt: The Temple of Saturn and the Roman Forum in Rome.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Jon Gudorf Photography · CC BY-SA 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Santa Maria Maggiore
places.summary: Papal basilica with golden mosaics. Free entry.
places.imageAlt: The façade and bell tower of the basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore in Rome.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Diego Delso · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: San Giovanni in Laterano
places.summary: Cathedral of Rome. Huge nave and Apostle statues.
places.imageAlt: The façade of San Giovanni in Laterano, the cathedral of Rome.
places.imageCredit: Photo: MrPanyGoff · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Scala Santa
places.summary: Holy Stairs (kneeling) / side stairs for walking. Brief look with toddlers.
places.imageAlt: The Scala Santa building next to the Lateran in Rome.
places.imageCredit: Photo: antmoose · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Santa Croce in Gerusalemme
places.summary: Optional short stop. Relic chapel may be closed for renovation — check first.
places.imageAlt: The baroque façade of Santa Croce in Gerusalemme in Rome.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Fallaner · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Isola Tiberina / San Bartolomeo
places.summary: Island stroll and brief church peek. Prefer taxi over long cobbles with a stroller.
places.imageAlt: Isola Tiberina, the island in the Tiber in Rome.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Alexkom000 · CC BY 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Glass Hostaria
places.summary: Anniversary dinner pick. Vicolo del Cinque 58, Trastevere. Wed–Sun dinner. No table held yet.

places.name: L’Arcangelo
places.summary: Walkable Prati alternate for anniversary dinner. Confirm November hours by phone.

places.name: Despar Prati
places.summary: Supermarket at Viale Giulio Cesare 193, near Ottaviano. Grocery stop for apartment breakfasts.

places.name: Mercato Rionale Prati
places.summary: Neighborhood market in Piazza dell’Unità, Prati. Fruit, veg, and deli counters for the apartment.

places.name: Il Matriciano
places.summary: Classic Roman trattoria in Prati, Via dei Gracchi 55. Closed Wednesday; Sunday dinner closed.

places.name: Osteria dei Gracchi
places.summary: Neighborhood osteria at Via dei Gracchi 19, Prati. Roman cooking near Ottaviano.

places.name: Trattoria Micci
places.summary: Prati trattoria-pizzeria since 1936, Via Andrea Doria 55 a/b. Closed Monday.

places.name: La Campana
places.summary: Historic Roman restaurant (from 1518) on Vicolo della Campana, near the Pantheon. Closed Monday.

places.name: Dar Bruttone Rione Monti
places.summary: Roman cooking on Via dei Serpenti 113, Monti, near the Colosseum.

places.name: Osteria Al Vicolo 9
places.summary: Monti osteria at Vicolo dei Serpenti 9. Closed Sunday.

places.name: Osteria Faleria
places.summary: Roman/Lazio osteria near San Giovanni, Via Faleria 47. Family-friendlier than a tiny tasting room for 9.

places.name: Pepe San Giovanni
places.summary: Family-scale restaurant/pizzeria at Via Gallia 103, near the Lateran.

places.name: Al Pompiere
places.summary: Historic Roman trattoria in the Ghetto, Piazza delle Cinque Scole 28. Closed Tuesday; Sunday lunch.

places.name: Cantina Cantarini
places.summary: Roman and Marchigiana osteria at Piazza Sallustio 12 (Sallustiano, short taxi from Prati). Closed Sunday.

places.name: La Pratolina
places.summary: Neighborhood pizzeria in Prati, Via degli Scipioni 248/250. Roman-style pizza for a family table.

places.name: Flavio al Velavevodetto
places.summary: Classic Testaccio pasta osteria under Monte Testaccio, Via di Monte Testaccio 97. Large enough for a family.

places.name: Cacio e Pepe
places.summary: Roman pasta trattoria at Via Giuseppe Avezzana 11, Prati. Compact rooms — two tables likely. Closed Sunday.

places.name: Dal Toscano
places.summary: Tuscan trattoria in Prati, Via Germanico 58/60. Closed Monday. Dinner kitchen from 20:00.

places.name: Pizzarium Bonci
places.summary: Gabriele Bonci’s pizza al taglio counter, Via della Meloria 43, Prati. Standing / queue; may split the group.

places.name: Osteria dell’Angelo
places.summary: Casual Roman osteria in Prati, Via Giovanni Bettolo 24–32. Closed Sunday. Dinner listings from 19:30.

places.name: Tazza d’Oro
places.summary: Historic Roman coffee bar at Via degli Orfani 84, next to the Pantheon. Stand at the counter like locals.
places.imageAlt: The storefront of Tazza d’Oro coffee bar near the Pantheon.
places.imageCredit: Photo: lienyuan lee · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Giolitti
places.summary: Historic gelateria at Via Uffici del Vicario 40, between the Pantheon and Trevi.
places.imageAlt: Cups of gelato at Giolitti in Rome.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Sv32000 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Sciascia Caffè 1919
places.summary: Old-school Prati coffee at Via Fabio Massimo 1/A. Cornetto at the bar, not a tourist piazza.

places.name: Gelateria dei Gracchi
places.summary: Artisanal gelato at Via dei Gracchi 272, Prati. On the walk home from Castel Sant’Angelo.

places.name: Fatamorgana Monti
places.summary: Creative artisanal gelato at Piazza degli Zingari 5, Monti, near Via dei Serpenti.

places.name: Trapizzino Testaccio
places.summary: Original Trapizzino at Via Giovanni Branca 88, Testaccio. Supplì and stuffed pizza triangles.
places.imageAlt: A trapizzino stuffed with pollo alla cacciatora.
places.imageCredit: Photo: Diego Zitelli · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Pasticceria Regoli
places.summary: Esquilino pastry shop since 1916, Via dello Statuto 60. Famous for maritozzo con la panna. Closed Tuesday.

places.name: Pasticceria Boccione
places.summary: No-sign kosher bakery at Via del Portico d’Ottavia 1. Pizza ebraica. Closed Saturday; Sunday until 17:30.
places.imageAlt: The no-sign storefront of Pasticceria Boccione in Rome’s Jewish Ghetto.
places.imageCredit: Photo: JSFarman · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Fior di Luna
places.summary: Artisanal gelato and chocolate at Via della Lungaretta 96, Trastevere, near the Tiber Island path.
